title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: build custom engine agents with the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, publishing and blocking controls, and corrected deployment sequence are supported. Minor corrections remain for a missing privacy citation, inconsistent wording in Microsoft's custom-app settings documentation, and checklist controls missing from the table.
